name: CSV Formula Shield
changes: The Audit chosen CSV files (Pro) command now shows a notice with a Sponsor on GitHub button for free users.
tip: Turn on Retain strict negative numbers to keep values such as -12 and -0.5.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. CSV Formula Shield is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your tables.

related.blurb: Check CSV columns against local rules and show errors by row and column.

related.blurb: Export Markdown tables to UTF-8 CSV files with a preview.
